episodes.title: Welcome to Widow's Bay!
episodes.summary: We hope you enjoyed the three hour ferry to New England's best kept secret! Ignore the warnings about the fog. Everything's fine.

episodes.title: Lodging
episodes.summary: Cherish the historical charm of our local inn, which Mayor Loftis will prove is safe by spending a night there alone.

episodes.title: The Inaugural Swim
episodes.summary: It's time for the annual beach opening. Lay out a towel as the mayor "tests the waters." Unrelated: Do not pick up hitchhikers.

episodes.title: Beach Reads
episodes.summary: Make sure you pack a good read for the beach! (We do not recommend self-help books on the island.)

episodes.title: What to Expect on Your Trip
episodes.summary: We apologize for the curfew. Please remain calm as we determine what's happening. On a separate note, keep your teenagers inside after dark.

episodes.title: Our History
episodes.summary: The history of Widow's Bay is a beautiful tale of marriage, loyalty, and a love that endures beyond lifetimes. That's all.

episodes.title: Seasickness
episodes.summary: Set out to sea with Mayor Loftis and cherished local figure, Wyck! They are attending to some business - best to simply enjoy the voyage.

episodes.title: Your Baggage
episodes.summary: Don't worry about misplaced luggage. Old baggage always resurfaces in Widow's Bay.

episodes.title: Emergency Shelter
episodes.summary: Please seek shelter should a centuries-old storm rage toward the island and plunge us into darkness. Enjoy a card game.

episodes.title: We Hope You Enjoyed Your Time!
episodes.summary: Season finale. We understand that hard choices had to be made and we may never be the same, but we hope you'll visit again!
